tania_cs: Polar Labs onboarding stuck. Their Web SDK init intermittently returns 401 then a burst of 429s. Started after they enabled Corp SSO proxy. Need quick triage.
osman_dev: Repro: Web page loads -> SDK init POST /v1/init -> sometimes 401 then immediate retries cause 429s. Only when routed through their SSO appliance.
lee_engineer: can you paste sanitized headers? suspect proxy adding duplicate Authorization or mangling x-forwarded headers.
osman_dev: snippet: Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
User-Agent: PolarWeb/4.1
X-SSO: on
rachel_devex: two Authorization headers is likely root cause. Our token validator uses the first header. If proxy injects a second updated token, first may be stale -> 401 -> client retries -> rate spike. Recommend client strip duplicates and add small jitter to retries.
lee_engineer: low-risk server change: iterate auth headers and accept first valid token, with audit log. I'll prototype on staging behind a flag.
tania_cs: ops-bot, create incident and tag AM as risk.
ops-bot: incident CS-3112-polar-auth-dupe created (prio: medium).
osman_dev: will toggle passthrough for a 10m test and deploy header-cleaner on client. Report back in 12m.
lee_engineer: will open PR with flag + audit log.
tania_cs: thanks, team — keep AM updated.
